entries.scenario: Java Recovery Agent product UI: incident intake, healthy baseline, controlled development failure, unhealthy observation, policy/budget, bounded recovery, authoritative verification, audit, and MCP discovery
entries.environment: Tavall Cloud DEVELOPMENT; packaged Java Recovery Agent over loopback MCP; disposable PostgreSQL state schema and typed loopback node gateway
entries.action: The browser operator used the Java Recovery Agent product surface to inspect the configured service, observe the real Cloud service after a controlled stop, evaluate recovery readiness, invoke the trusted bounded recovery action, and open the resulting audit and MCP pages.
entries.authoritativeVerification: The Java recovery_recover call returned successfully after the typed node gateway started the named Tavall Cloud service; the final Java service_inspect reported healthy=true and the Cloud service projection reported RUNNING with /healthz HTTP 200.

entries.scenario: Controlled development service failure and bounded recovery
entries.environment: Tavall Cloud DEVELOPMENT on dev-storage; loopback control and node adapters
entries.action: Typed Tavall Cloud stop created the controlled fault; Java service_inspect and recovery_readiness observed it; Java recovery_recover invoked the restricted node gateway, restarted the real service, and waited for bounded health verification.
entries.authoritativeVerification: Recovery returned RECOVERED with HTTP 200 from the fixed /healthz probe; the final Tavall Cloud service inspect returned desiredState RUNNING and actualState RUNNING.

entries.scenario: Extended packaged Java Recovery Agent capture with visible policy, restart, and final verification stages
entries.environment: Tavall Cloud DEVELOPMENT on dev-storage; disposable loopback node gateway and PostgreSQL schema
entries.action: The browser capture drove the packaged Java Recovery Agent over Streamable HTTP MCP: it confirmed the healthy baseline, stopped the named Cloud development service through typed Cloud control, observed the stopped target, evaluated Java policy and durable budget, invoked operator-only recovery, and displayed the resulting state.
entries.authoritativeVerification: Java recovery_recover returned RECOVERED; final service_inspect returned healthy=true; the restricted node gateway observed /healthz HTTP 200; and Tavall Cloud PostgreSQL projection returned desiredState RUNNING and actualState RUNNING. The temporary schema and node gateway were removed after capture.
